prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1212; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle inspected at the body shop following a sideswipe that occurred during a lane change. The damage is concentrated along the right rear quarter panel and rear bumper cover, with scuffing and paint transfer consistent with the reported contact. Panel replacement and refinishing of the rear quarter, along with bumper cover repair and replacement of the damaged reflector bracket, make up the repair plan. Labor hours for each operation fit the extent of the damage as observed. Shop invoices reviewed show no repeated charges for the same work. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from the records available.
